scenes.name: the-garden-has-a-shell
scenes.prompt: The lush fern garden is cradled inside a transparent elongated crystal chamber. As we withdraw, the delicate pearly ribs complete a graceful seed-shaped outline around this same green pocket. Curled fern leaves, a deep teal pool, mossy islets and tiny coral flowers remain visible inside the shell. Exquisite translucent opal and clear emerald glass, tiny silver filaments and filigree along the edges. The surrounding pale mineral framework recedes softly, revealing more of the chamber without hiding its living interior. Intimate jewel-like dimensional sculpture, extremely intricate details, dreamy cyan and rose reflections. No people, no text, no border.

scenes.name: one-seed-with-another-world
scenes.prompt: The entire translucent seed-shaped crystal chamber is coming into view, a luminous miniature alien jungle held inside delicate silver and opalescent ribs. Curled ferns surround a tiny teal river and coral flowers within its emerald interior. The graceful elongated shell hangs among the lace-like branches of an enormous pale crystalline garden. Other smaller glass seeds and soft rose-cyan lights recede into atmospheric depth. The central living seed remains the clear focal form as space opens around it. Intricate carved mineral lace, prismatic translucent surfaces, luminous green life within pale sculptural geometry, extraordinary detail. No people, no text, no frame.

motion_note.intent: From the actual fern-filled chamber, carry the incoming move into one outward reveal. Keep the green interior readable while the pearly outline becomes a seed-like shell among a larger garden. End with gentle continuing outward motion, no cut or dissolve.
